scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/kaltak/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/kaltak
  set jcr:title{String} to "News Hub Assets"
end

set ACL for kaltak-content-reader
  allow jcr:read on /content/kaltak/en/news
end

set ACL for kaltak-content-writer
  allow jcr:read on /content/kaltak/en
  allow jcr:write on /content/kaltak/en
end
